objects.taxonomy_description: Handheld collapsible canopy mounted on a central shaft with radiating ribs. Canopy is fabric (nylon, polyester) stretched over 6-8 metal or fiberglass ribs. When open, diameter is 90-120 cm. Shaft is metal or wood with a curved or straight handle. Collapsible models fold down to 25-35 cm via a telescoping shaft and folding ribs. Ribs converge at a runner that slides along the shaft.
